title: Merodach-baladan’s embassy
summary: Merodach-baladan sends letters and a present to Hezekiah (2 Kgs 20:12).
description: Merodach-baladan sends letters and a present to Hezekiah (2 Kgs 20:12). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 713 BC. Sort changed by the Reply to Beckman pass (2026-11-13): was ussher-jones 712 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 2, row 713 (Ussher-Jones column), p. 40
chronologies.note: Merodach-Baladan sends a messenger seeking Hezekiah as an ally. The Jones Appendix F entry stored here reads 712.

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
